question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Besides**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given passage is about the 'Human Skeleton System'.
 
• The most appropriate word for the first blank is 'Besides'.
 
• It means 'in addition to or as well as somebody/something; also'. (के अतिरिक्त, के साथ; भी)
 
 
• *Example: There will be six people coming, **besides** you and Raj.*
 
 
 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Unless**: if... not; except if. (यदि... नहीं; तब तक नहीं जब तक)
 
• **Beside**: at the side of, or next to somebody/something. (के बग़ल में, के पास)
 
• **Although**: in spite of the fact that. (यद्यपि, हालाँकि)
 
 
 
• As per the above definition, we find that the correct answer is** Option 1.**

 

**Correct Passage:__** *The human skeleton is the internal framework of our body. It gives shape and support to the body. **Besides**, it provides protection, makes blood cells, stores minerals and regulates hormones. The spinal cord is an (3)______ part of our body. The ribcage protects our lungs and heart. To increase the (4)______ of our bones, we should include calcium in our diet. All our (5)______ organs are protected by this skeletal system.*

44:Tb7e,

The correct answer is '**important**'.
